result.summary: The image depicts a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks and row-house frontage. Pedestrian safety is compromised by a lack of marked crossings and significant visual obstructions caused by dense on-street parallel parking. No traffic calming or dedicated pedestrian infrastructure beyond basic sidewalks is visible.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by vehicles parked perpendicularly across the sidewalk, almost entirely blocking the walkway. This forces pedestrians to walk in the roadway, creating a high-risk situation on a residential street.

interventions.title: Formalize On-Street Parking
interventions.description: Reconfigure the street to provide parallel parking that does not encroach on the walkway, ensuring a minimum 5-foot clear path.
